candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable, while inventory and payment succeed. Gateway logs show transport ReadTimeouts to order and 502s on /v1/checkout; metrics show elevated checkout p95 latency. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency.
